comparison.objective: File a steel block flat to a scribed line.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual file stabilization, even pressure and repeated push strokes for controlled material removal.
comparison.success_condition: Surface reaches line and flatness tolerances without over-filing; file returned and released.
comparison.reason: Although both regulate tool force and prohibit damage, filing tests distributed abrasive strokes and flatness, not aligned hammer impact, discrete fracture or fragment recovery.
